He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Rice Owls men's basketball|Rice Owls]] and the [[Xavier Musketeers men's basketball|Xavier Musketeers]]. ==High school career== Olivari attended [[Westlake High School (Georgia)|Westlake]] at [[Atlanta|Atlanta, Georgia]], where he averaged 15 points, six rebounds, four assists and two steals as a senior and led the team to state and region championships in 2016, the regional finals in 2017 and the Sweet 16 in 2018.{{cite web|title=Quincy Olivari - Men's Basketball|url=https://goxavier.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/quincy-olivari/11403|work=Xavier University Athletics|access-date=August 15, 2024}} ==College career== Olivari played four collegiate seasons at [[Rice Owls men's basketball|Rice]] and one at [[Xavier Musketeers men's basketball|Xavier]]. He led the Owls and was third in Conference USA in scoring with 18.7 points per game and was also third in C-USA with 94 three-pointers, in minutes with 33.6, sixth in field goal percentage with .413, ninth in free throw percentage with .793, and 11th in rebounding with 5.9. His 94 three-pointers in a season are the second-most school history and his 654 points are the fifth-most in a season among the Owls.{{cite web|title=Quincy Olivari - Men's Basketball|url=https://riceowls.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/quincy-olivari/7723|work=Rice University Athletics|access-date=August 15, 2024}}{{cite web|first=Tim|last=Andrzejewski|title=Quincy Olivari Signs Exhibit 10 Contract with Los Angeles Lakers|url=https://riceowls.com/news/2024/6/28/mens-basketball-quincy-olivari-signs-exhibit-10-contract-with-los-angeles-lakers|website=RiceOwls.com|date=June 28, 2024|access-date=August 15, 2024}} In his lone season as a Musketeer, Olivari appeared in and started 34 games while averaging 19.1 points, 5.6 rebounds, 2.1 assists and 1.4 steals in 32.2 minutes. He finished the season as the Big East’s leader in 3-point field goal percentage with .409 and was voted Big East Honorable Mention for his play.{{cite web|title=Los Angeles Lakers Sign Kylor Kelley and Quincy Olivari|url=https://www.nba.com/lakers/news/los-angeles-lakers-sign-kylor-kelley-and-quincy-olivari-081424|website=NBA.com|date=August 14, 2024|access-date=August 15, 2024}} ==Professional career== After going undrafted in the [[2024 NBA draft]], Olivari joined the [[Los Angeles Lakers]] for the [[2024 NBA Summer League]]{{cite web|title=LAKERS ANNOUNCE 2024 SUMMER LEAGUE ROSTER AND SCHEDULE|url=https://www.culvercityobserver.com/story/2024/07/11/sports/lakers-announce-2024-summer-league-roster-and-schedule/13817.html|website=CulverCityObserver.com|date=July 11, 2024|access-date=August 15, 2024}} and on August 14, 2024, he signed with them on an [[exhibit 10]] contract. On October 19, his deal was converted into a [[two-way contract]].{{cite web|title=Los Angeles Lakers Convert Quincy Olivari to Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/lakers/news/los-angeles-lakers-convert-quincy-olivari-to-two-way-contract|website=NBA.com|date=October 19, 2024|access-date=October 20, 2024}}{{cite web|title=Lakers sign standout rookie Olivari to 2-way deal|url=https://www.espn.com.au/nba/story/_/id/41888188/lakers-ink-preseason-standout-quincy-olivari-2-way-contract|website=ESPN.com|date=October 19, 2024|access-date=October 20, 2024}} On December 12, he signed a multiyear sneaker deal with [[Under Armour]]'s Curry Brand.{{cite web|title=Quincy Olivari Officially Signs Sneaker Deal with Curry Brand|url=https://www.si.com/fannation/sneakers/news/quincy-olivari-officially-signs-sneaker-deal-with-curry-brand|work=Kicks on SI|publisher=SI.com|date=December 12, 2024|access-date=January 16, later, he joined South Bay.{{cite tweet|author=South Bay Lakers|title=OFFICIAL: The South Bay Lakers have acquired the returning player rights to guard Quincy Olivari.|number=1882160487632413131|user=SouthBayLakers|date=January 22, 2025|access-date=January 22, 2025}} On July 5, Olivari was added to the roster of the [[Brooklyn Nets]] for the [[2025 NBA Summer League|2025 NBA 2K26 Summer League]], but did not make the final roster.{{cite web | last=Carmona | first=Tyler | title=Report: Former Laker took join Brooklyn Nets for Summer League | website=Brooklyn Nets On SI | date=2025-07-06 | url=https://www.si.com/nba/nets/onsi/news/report-former-laker-to-join-brooklyn-nets-for-summer-league-quincy-olivari | access-date=2025-12-05}} On September 23, 2025, Olivari signed a two way deal with the [[Detroit Pistons]]. Two day later he was waived by the Pistons.{{Cite web |date=2025-09-27 |title=Detroit Pistons Make Decision on Recent Pickup Quincy Olivari |url=https://www.si.com/nba/pistons/onsi/news/detroit-pistons-make-decision-on-recent-pickup-quincy-olivari-01k66fby0y7b |access-date=2025-12-09 |website=Detroit Pistons On SI |language=en-US}} After acquiring his returning playing rights from the South Bay Lakers, Olivari was signed by the Motor City Cruise.
